content:
maria: Heads-up: locking the kernel + quant rollout for Fri 05:30 UTC quiet window. Plan: canary 2% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%. We need final sign-off on pins, prewarm, and rollback triggers.

aj: Which kernel/quant artifacts?

maria: engine-kernel@4.13.0-rc1 and quant-bundle@v2.6-q8. This is the first release with the new tiling matmul kernel. Pin TTL 90m for the night-bucket.

luka: ran a focused perf sweep in staging. Observed a 12% p95 latency increase on long-context chat traces until KV cache warmed. No OOMs but CPU stitch spikes on a few hosts. I put flamegraphs in the perf board.

nikhil: rollback rules proposal: auto-hold + alert if p95 >+8% for two consecutive 5m windows OR error-rate +0.3% absolute OR host CPU >92% for 3 hosts in 10m OR any OOM. Auto-rollback to engine-kernel@4.12.1 + quant-bundle@v2.6-q7. Agree?

aj: Agree on p95 and errors. For CPU, let's say 2 hosts within 8 minutes to avoid noisy single-host blips. Also enable auto-fallback to q7 on eval drop >1.5% EM score.

maria: done. Jen, marketing copy?

jen: Drafted short release note: "Introducing tiled-matmul kernel 4.13.0-rc1 with improved memory locality and reduced peak GPU memory for many encoder-decoder workloads. Default quant bundle q8; q7 available as fallback." Will add a "Canary in progress" line.

aj: Pre-bake and signature check commands I'll run at T-20m:
```
/deploybot bake engine-kernel@4.13.0-rc1 --region=eu-west-1
/deploybot verify-signature engine-kernel@4.13.0-rc1
/deploybot pin quant-bundle@v2.6-q8 --scope=night-bucket --ttl=90m
```

deploybot: DeployBot: rollout scheduled by @maria R-7900012. Canary stages: 2%,15%,50%,100%. Rollout window: 2026-03-27 05:30 UTC -> 07:00 UTC. Pins applied on night-bucket.

luka: Bake report: binaries present on canary hosts, signature OK, initial microbench shows p95 +6% after warm; CPU spike still shows on 1 host under synthetic load.

maria: we'll start canary but hold on region-wide prewarm. Tom, you're on metrics?

tom: watching dashboards. I set an alert to post here if any guard trips. Also linked runbook (rls-runbook/v2).

deploybot: DeployBot: canary traffic switched to engine-kernel@4.13.0-rc1 for 2% R-7900012. Telemetry guard enabled.

nikhil: Telemetry at T+6m: p95 +7%, errors +0.01%, CPU anomaly on 1 host (89%). No OOMs. Still within thresholds.

aj: starting eval job (A/B) for chat prompt set. Will post exact-match delta.

luka: noticed KV cold starts causing the biggest tail. Can we prefill KV on a subset of canaries?

maria: yes, do a small prefix warm on the next 15% slice. Add prewarm step to the stage.

deploybot: DeployBot: advancing to 15% R-7900012. Prewarm script executed for warmed hosts.

nikhil: At 15% stage: p95 +2%, errors steady, CPU normalized. Eval EM delta -0.9% (within fallback threshold). Looks good.

aj: eval finished: EM -0.85% vs baseline. I'll hold until 50% if metrics stay green.

luka: one canary host threw a CUDA hang at 15% but it auto-restarted and recovered. Logging incident in infra. No user-facing errors.

maria: we need to capture the failure signature for postmortem. If repeats -> rollback.

deploybot: DeployBot: moving to 50% R-7900012. Guard=telemetry.

nikhil: 50% snapshot: p95 +1.5%, errors +0.02%, no OOMs, CPU okay. However, a small group of long-context eval traces show degraded token-level perplexity; monitoring.

aj: suggest turning on q7 auto-fallback for the long-context route only if perplexity drift >2%. I'll add route-level fallback rules.

maria: do it. Also reminder: update changelog entry and push release-note final at 08:00 UTC. Unpin after 90m TTL or manually at 08:00 UTC.

deploybot: DeployBot: rollout R-7900012 succeeded at 100% engine-kernel@4.13.0-rc1 / quant-bundle@v2.6-q8. Manual unpin scheduled at 08:00 UTC.

jen: customer note queued for 08:15 UTC.

maria: thanks team. We'll keep watch for 4 hours and collect any anomalies for the postmortem. If anything flaps, we'll follow the rollback rules above. :white_check_mark:
